description: Obtaining Low Floor Buses provided as a Grant by the Government of Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - During the meeting held between the President of Sri Lanka and the visiting Japanese Parliamentary Vice-Minister for Foreign Affairs in February 2025, attention was drawn to how Japan could support the public bus transport sector in Sri Lanka. During the discussions held with the Japanese Embassy in Sri Lanka in that regard, the Government of Japan has agreed to provide 08 used low-floor buses to the country as a Grant. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to obtain the said Grant to the country, was approved by the Cabinet.
